description_en: Retrieves the elastic QPS time-series data for an Anti-DDoS instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例弹性QPS账单曲线图
name: DescribeElasticQps

parameters.help_en:
The service region. Valid values:

cn: Chinese mainland.

cn-hongkong: Outside Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
服务地域。取值：
cn：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：非中国内地
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的IP地址
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The start of the query time range, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

The timestamp must be the start of a minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the query time range, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

The timestamp must be the start of a minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The sampling interval, in seconds. The value must be a multiple of 60. The default value is 60
parameters.help_zh: 采样间隔，单位：秒。必须是60秒的倍数，默认60s。返回结果可缩放
parameters.name: interval
